title: Interpolate Curve Missing From Document
description: After creating interpolate curve, no curve shape appears under shape document. Fix typology object binding on commit.
summary: Interpolate curve commits added wire/edge geometry but no typology object row appeared in the shape document because typology JSON listed the wrong interaction id (`curve.interpolate-curve` vs `curve.interpolateCurve`), so `typologyIdForInteractionCommit` returned null and `ensureTypologyObjectFromCreateDiff` never ran. Fixed interaction id references on InterpolateCurve, ControlPointCurve, ExtrudeCurve, and NetworkSurface typologies; added `produces.typology` fallback in `typologyIdForInteractionCommit`; added integration test asserting document object binding after interpolate curve commit.
